protocol: Select the two lowest IDs in the fixed MT3 test partition, all isolated parts and original mixtures.
Predict from original audio only, no transcription labels, MIDI, chart Timing or source program hints.
Evaluate onset and release on the same unshifted physical audio clock; no chart lead or grid snapping.
This partition is also used for upstream validation; it is not a newly held-out model test set.
Aligned Notes annotations can have boundary uncertainty; report strict and duration-relative tolerances.

tolerances.standard: 50ms onset; offset max(50ms,20% reference duration); exact semitone

limits: All predictions retained, including incorrect instrument families and spurious drum events.
All attacks in the scoring window enter interval denominators, even if predicted tails exceed the window or context.
Reference tails must be observable in inference context; no end-based prediction filtering.
The legacy strict key means fixed 40/80ms, not universally stricter: 80ms is wider than 50ms for short tails.
Instrument metrics require exact program; sax subtype labels in upstream preprocessing are uncertain.
Physical audio endpoints are not authored LN-release choices.
